heard: A strange orange light flickered over the East London docks. At 6.52 pm, shockwaves from Silvertown reached houses in Norfolk. Neighbors feared a German air raid or secret sabotage. Instead, 50 tons of TNT detonated in the crowded factory. The government report into the 73 deaths stayed secret for decades. It revealed officials ignored warnings because they deemed production worth the risk. — witnesses never forgot how the orange light first appeared.
